welcome.title: Welcome to WhisperSM
welcome.description: Dictate in any app with a single shortcut. Transcription and AI rewriting run on your computer, so nothing you say leaves it.

modes.title: Modes
modes.description: A mode rewrites your transcription with an AI model: fix punctuation, turn it into an email, a chat message or notes. Trigger a mode with its own shortcut, or press its number key while recording.
modes.empty: Create a mode to clean up or reformat your dictation with AI.
modes.hint: The first mode is used by the “Dictate with AI mode” shortcut. Drag-free: edit a mode to change its number key or shortcut.

aiShortcut.title: AI shortcut
aiShortcut.description: A second global shortcut that dictates and applies your default mode automatically.

dialog.subtitle: Describe how the transcription should be rewritten and pick the AI model that runs it.

dialog.name: Name
dialog.typeAiHint: A language model rewrites the transcription with your prompt.
dialog.promptPlaceholder: Describe how the transcription should be rewritten…

modes.info: A mode decides which voice model transcribes your speech and, optionally, which AI model rewrites the result. The active mode is used by the main shortcut.

speech.description: Speech-to-text models run fully offline. Pick one that matches your languages and your machine.
speech.noneDownloaded: No speech model downloaded yet. Pick one below.

ai.description: AI models power modes. On-device models never send your text anywhere; cloud providers need an API key.
ai.localDescription: Runs inside WhisperSM. No account, no network, no data leaves your computer.
ai.cloudDescription: Optional. Use OpenAI, Anthropic, Groq and others with your own API key.
ai.tryHint: Run a mode on a sample text to check speed and quality on this machine.
ai.trySample: um so basically i think we should uh move the meeting to thursday at three because tuesday doesnt work for me
ai.deleteConfirm: Delete {{model}} from this computer? You can download it again later.
ai.privacyNote: Models are downloaded once from Hugging Face and stored in the app data folder.

settingsPage.description: Shortcuts, audio, output and app behaviour.
settingsPage.debugHint: Press Ctrl/Cmd + Shift + D to show the debug page. Something wrong?

history.description: Every dictation, with its audio, raw and AI-processed text.

about.tagline: Private speech to text with on-device AI post-processing. Free and open source.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.localDescription: Audio, transcription and on-device AI never leave this machine. Cloud providers are only used if you add one yourself.

credits.description: WhisperSM stands on the shoulders of these projects.
credits.handy: The open-source speech-to-text app WhisperSM is built on.
credits.parler: Melvynx's fork that introduced modes and the modern post-processing pipeline.
credits.whisper: High-performance inference for OpenAI's Whisper models.
credits.candle: Hugging Face's Rust inference engine used for on-device language models.
credits.models: Open-weight language models used for on-device post-processing.

vocabulary.title: Vocabulary
vocabulary.empty: Add names, brands or jargon so they are spelled right. Use “Replace with…” to rewrite what the model hears (“super whisper” → “Superwhisper”).
vocabulary.importHint: One entry per line. Write “heard -> written” for a replacement.

alwaysShow.title: Always show
alwaysShow.description: Keep the recording window on screen between recordings.

pushToTalk.title: Push to Talk
pushToTalk.description: Hold to record, release when done

aiShortcut.title: Dictate with AI
aiShortcut.description: Records and applies the default AI mode

autoUpdate.title: Automatically check for updates
autoUpdate.description: Look for new versions on GitHub when the app starts.

launchOnLogin.title: Launch on login
launchOnLogin.description: Start WhisperSM automatically when you log in.

errorLogging.title: Error logging
errorLogging.description: Write detailed logs to help diagnose problems. Off keeps only errors.

keepRecordings.title: Keep recordings for
keepRecordings.description: Audio files are deleted after this period. Starred entries are always kept.

activeDuration.title: Voice model active duration
activeDuration.description: How long the model stays loaded in memory after a recording.

language.title: Spoken language
language.description: Auto detects the language. Choosing one improves accuracy for it.

translate.title: Translate to English

holdToTalk.title: Hold the main shortcut to record
holdToTalk.description: When off, press once to start and once to stop.

folder.title: App folder location

clipboard.title: Clipboard content
clipboard.description: What stays in the clipboard after the text is pasted.

paste.title: Paste result text
paste.description: Insert the text into the active app. When off, the text only goes to history and the clipboard.

autoSend.title: Auto-send after paste
autoSend.description: Press a key after pasting, to send a message right away.

simulate.title: Simulate keypresses
simulate.description: Type the text key by key instead of pasting. Slower, but works in apps that block paste.

trailingSpace.title: Append trailing space
trailingSpace.description: Add a space after the pasted text.

startHidden.title: Start hidden
startHidden.description: Launch in the menu bar without opening the window.

trayIcon.title: Show menu bar icon
trayIcon.description: Show the WhisperSM icon in the menu bar / system tray.

silenceRemoval.title: Silence removal
silenceRemoval.description: Drop silent parts before transcribing. Faster and fewer hallucinations.

playback.title: Playback when recording

alwaysOn.title: Always-on microphone
alwaysOn.description: Keep the microphone open for a faster start.

output.title: Output device
